source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyayas 19–20: the sisters fly over the ocean, described at length (its monsters, its jewels, the fire under the sea); the serpents, having agreed among themselves, become black hairs in the horse's tail; the sisters see the tail black, and Vinata, defeated, becomes Kadru's slave (as Aruna had cursed, 1.14). The cliffhanger opens Garuda's birth (1.20).
structure: From episode 11: COLD OPEN (the hook over the episode's strongest image, big on-screen text from frame 1; KIT.series.hookCard) → title (the hook's post) → RECAP (≈2.5 s) → STORY (with a brief cut to Sauti at the Naimisha fire) → the cliffhanger image + line → a silent ≈1.5 s Next card that dissolves back into the first frame (KIT.series.loopNextScene).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Who won the bet: the honest sister, or the one who cheated?
lines.say: Who won the bet: [p:80] the honest sister, [p:60] or the one who cheated?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (moving from frame 1): the two sisters LARGE in the foreground flying over the dawn ocean, the white horse on a far shore ahead; the question in big text from frame 1.

lines.text: Kadru ordered her sons to hang from the horse's tail as black hairs.
lines.say: Kadru ordered her sons to hang from the horse's tail as black hairs.
lines.note: RECAP: episode 17's image as a memory: Kadru in the serpents' grove, her sons rearing round her.

lines.text: The sisters flew out over the ocean, the home of all the waters.
lines.say: The sisters flew out over the ocean, [p:80] the home of all the waters.
lines.note: STORY 1. NEW SHOT: from high above, the sisters small over the vast dawn ocean, waves wheeling below (EP17.ocean); the camera follows them.

lines.text: Below them moved monsters and jewels, and a fire that burns beneath the sea.
lines.say: Below them moved monsters and jewels, [p:100] and a fire that burns beneath the sea.
lines.note: STORY 2: a cut-away under the surface: makaras and glinting jewels (beats[0..1]); deep down, the fire under the sea (the mare-headed submarine fire of the epic's ocean) glows red (beats[2..3]).

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: One flew in hope. The other already knew.
lines.say: One flew in hope. [p:200] The other already knew.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, close, a seventh angle: his hands in the firelight, a slow gesture of two hands, one raised, one turned down).

lines.text: In the night, her sons had done as she asked.
lines.say: In the night, [p:80] her sons had done as she asked.
lines.note: STORY 3 (a flashback in cold blue): night on the shore; dark serpents slip up into the sleeping horse's white tail and hang there (pose.tail rising). The CE: the serpents agreed among themselves to do it. THE TURN (≈ 51 %): the cheat revealed to the viewer before Vinata sees it.

lines.text: They came down where the horse stood.
lines.say: They came down where the horse stood.
lines.note: STORY 4: dawn on the far shore: the sisters alight beside the horse, seen from behind them.
STORY 5 · THE REVEAL (≈ 50 %): after a 400 ms rest, a slow push in along the horse to his tail: streaked with black hairs (beats[1], a deep drum).
STORY 6: close on Vinata's face, the rose light draining from her rim; Kadru's green glint at the edge of the frame.

lines.text: She bowed her head, and became her sister's slave.
lines.say: She bowed her head, [p:150] and became her sister's slave.
lines.note: STORY 7: Vinata bows (bow pose); her ornaments fall away and her sari's end covers her head (slave: true) on 'slave' (beats[1]); Kadru stands over her.

lines.text: Just as her son Aruna had cursed.
lines.say: Just as her son Aruna had cursed.
lines.note: STORY 8: the sky over them reddens: Aruna at the reins of the Sun's chariot, small and high, looks down (a callback to episode 10). (Remaster fix: 'foretold' softened Aruna's curse of CE 1.14; episode 10 says 'curse'.)

lines.text: Then the second egg cracked open, and the sky caught fire.
lines.say: Then the second egg cracked open… [p:100] and the sky caught fire.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger image): Kashyapa's hermitage: the gold egg in its jar; a crack of fire runs across it (beats[1]) and on 'fire' (beats[2]) light bursts out and floods the sky gold-red.
The short, silent Next card: a glimpse of episode 19: Garuda rising, wings spread, blazing; then the loop back to frame 1.
